offering_description.value: Owns and develops large master-planned communities in coastal California (Newhall Ranch/Valencia, San Francisco Shipyard and Candlestick, Great Park Neighborhoods in Irvine). Entitles and improves land, then sells residential and commercial lots to homebuilders and other buyers.

primary_products.value: entitled residential lots; commercial land parcels; mixed-use development land

primary_services.value: land entitlement and development; community management; infrastructure construction

customer_segment.value: B2B: homebuilders, commercial developers and land buyers

end_markets.value: residential real estate; commercial real estate; homebuilding

revenue_model.value: product sales: land sales of residential and commercial parcels to builders; commissions or management fees: management fees from the Great Park venture and builder-related participation; other: homesite and community participation payments from builders
revenue_model.category: product sales; commissions or management fees; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns, entitles and improves raw land, selling finished lots to homebuilders and developers

geography_served.value: US regional: California: Los Angeles County, San Francisco and Orange County

specialization.value: niche specialist: California master-planned land development across a few large communities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: lot and land sales directly to homebuilders and commercial buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land entitlement, zoning, CEQA environmental review and local government approvals in California
